home.subtitle: Purchases, prefinancing, cash, stock and payroll for cocoa buying stations — on one ledger your whole team can trust.

roles.label: signed with a name and a time

features.title: Built for the way a buying station really works.
features.subtitle: From the scale to the final report, each step lands in the same record.

purchases.title: Purchases & weighing
purchases.text: Gross, humidity, refraction and net for every delivery. Same-day deliveries roll into one purchase, each weighing kept.

prefinance.title: Prefinancing at the agreed price
prefinance.text: Advance money to trusted buyers. Their cocoa repays the debt at the price you agreed, automatically.

till.title: Till & provisions
till.text: Open a float, record each provision, pay at the scale. Close with a count and see the variance.

stock.title: Stock & truck loadings
stock.text: Stock moves with every purchase. Load trucks for commercial partners with a printed delivery note.

payroll.title: Payroll & payslips
payroll.text: Accrue salaries, pay from the till against a signature, print monthly payslips.

control.title: Roles, audit & control
control.text: Each person sees only what their role allows. Nothing is deleted quietly: payments are voided, never erased.

weigh.title: Weigh and record
weigh.text: The cashier records the delivery at the scale. Stock is received at once.

pay.title: Price and pay
pay.text: The right price is applied, a buyer's prefinance is repaid, the rest is paid now or later.

reconcile.title: Reconcile and report
reconcile.text: Close the till, print the reports and see every movement of the day.

documents.title: The paperwork prints itself.
documents.subtitle: Branded with your company's letterhead and watermark.

final.title: Ready for today's deliveries?
final.text: Sign in with the account your administrator gave you.

footer.illustrative: Figures shown on this page are illustrative.

plans.title: Simple yearly plans for cocoa businesses
plans.subtitle: Start free for 30 days. Pay once a year. Move to another plan whenever your business grows.
plans.unavailable: The plans cannot be shown right now. Please try again in a moment.
plans.trialText: Try everything in Pro with your own purchases, stock and staff. No payment needed to start.
plans.safeText: Reaching a limit only stops adding more. If you change plan or stop paying, everything you recorded stays readable and printable.
plans.payText: MTN MoMo or Orange Money, once a year. We set up your account and train your cashier at no extra cost.
